task.title: P6-177: Fix four docstrings and one doc line that contradict the code
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 10 — Hygiene and docs). Original id: P6-177. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/collection-api.md.

**Four docstrings and one doc line that contradict the code they document** (was `P6-012b` partial + `P6-012d` + `P6-012e` + `P6-055k` + `P6-069d`): `catalog/destination.rs:393-395` claims the sticky picker "SSRs (`/catalog` renders it for any session)" while `DestinationPicker:295-307` gates it on a signed-in caller; `collection.rs:396-398` claims the error arm is "the *only* thing on the page" while `QuickAddPanel` and the shell rail/tabs sit outside both `Transition`s and remain; `routes.rs:351-354`'s `/// POST /api/moves` block now sits above `move_holding` (`:355`) and `move_cards` (`:371`) lost its doc comment entirely; and `quick_add.rs:190` claims `here` is "the same number the page's HERE column renders" when that cell renders `present` plus a separate dimmed `+rollup` — the sum matches `here_total`, not the cell.
